key.name: tile-focused-application-windows
key.summary: Tile focused application windows on the current workspace and monitor

key.name: application-preferred-widths
key.description: Density hints of the form "application-name:width-in-pixels". The width controls how many grid columns an application targets on wide monitors; it is not a hard cap, so fewer windows still expand to fill the work area. An empty list disables all per-application width preferences.

key.name: portrait-minimum-tile-height
key.summary: Minimum tile height on portrait monitors
key.description: On portrait monitors windows stack top to bottom in a single full-height column. A non-positive value (the default) keeps every window in that one column; a positive value caps how many rows stack before the next window wraps onto a column to the right, so a column never drops below this many pixels tall. This trades pure vertical stacking for side-by-side columns once there are many windows on a tall monitor.
